source.publication: 2025 Individual Income Tax Booklet (Form ND-1 instructions and tables)
source.section: PDF p.14 Line 8 - U.S. Railroad Retirement Board benefits; Form ND-1 line 8; Form ND-1 lines 1b, 4b, 17, 18, 19, 20, 24, 25; booklet PDF p.4 (starting point is federal taxable income), PDF p.13 Line 1b, PDF p.16 Line 20, PDF p.29 Tax Rate Schedules, PDF pp.22-28 Tax Table

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 90,000.00 + railroad retirement (Tier 2, taxed federally as a pension) (person 0) 24,000.00 = 114,000.00. Federal taxable income = 114,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 98,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form ND-1 line 1b federal taxable income 98,250.00; lines 2-3 additions 0.00, line 4a 0.00; line 4b = 98,250.00. Subtractions: line 8 U.S. Railroad Retirement Board benefits 24,000.00. Line 17 total subtractions = 24,000.00. Line 18 North Dakota taxable income = 98,250.00 - 24,000.00 = 74,250.00. Line 19 = 74,250.00. Line 20 tax: 1.95% x (74,250.00 - 48,475.00) = 1.95% x 25,775.00 = 502.6125, to the cent 502.61; the Tax Table row 74,250 to 74,300 gives 503; expected uses the bracket formula on the exact income. Lines 21-23 credits: line 22 marriage penalty credit: not a joint return, so none. Expected credits 0.00. Line 25 net tax = 502.61.
accepted_approximations: Tax below 100,000 is figured on the exact income; the booklet uses a 50-dollar Tax Table row rounded to whole dollars.
